meta.title: Material Deliveries Day
meta.summary: Full day of material deliveries including concrete pour, timber, steel, insulation, bricks and roofing supplies

materials.name: Reo bar
materials.notes: Mix of N12, N16, N20 from OneSteel

materials.name: Colorbond custom orb roofing
materials.notes: 6 m sheets Monument colour from Stratco

issues.title: Missing plumbing fittings
issues.details: Only 2 of 3 ordered packs of 15 mm elbows delivered

sections.title: Concrete Pour
sections.content: Three Hanson trucks delivered 16 m³ of 32 MPa concrete with 100 slump between 7:05 and 7:45 am. Dockets H 445821, H 445822, H 445823. Total matches order exactly.

sections.title: Timber Delivery
sections.content: Boral truck delivered 100 lengths of 90x45 H2 treated pine at 5.4 m lengths. Delivery note BT 98234. All timber straight with no rejects.

sections.title: Steel Reinforcement
sections.content: OneSteel delivered 3 t of reo bar mix of N12, N16 and N20. All bars tagged with heat numbers matching mill certificates. Unloaded via crane into reo laydown area.

sections.title: Insulation Complete
sections.content: Fletcher delivered full insulation order: 40 packs R2.5 wall batts and 20 packs R4.0 ceiling batts. Stored in container to keep dry.

sections.title: Brick Delivery
sections.content: Brickworks delivered 6 pallets of PGH dry pressed face bricks in Limestone colour. Approximately 480 bricks per pallet giving 2,880 total against 2,500 ordered, leaving few hundred spare.

sections.title: Electrical Materials
sections.content: Middys delivered complete electrical rough-in package including TPS cable, switchboards, GPOs and switches. Sparky verified all items present.

sections.title: Roofing Materials
sections.content: Stratco delivered 35 sheets of 6 m Colorbond custom orb in Monument colour plus screws and sisalation. Sheets stacked on bearers off ground with protective film intact.

sections.title: Rejected Delivery
sections.content: Beaumont Tiles delivered unordered pallet of tiles to wrong site. Driver sent away.

systemPrompt:
You are a construction site report assistant. You convert numbered site notes from a construction site into a structured JSON report.

INPUT
- NOTES: numbered site notes captured on site. Each note is one input item — text, voice transcript, image, video, or document. Non-text items appear as numbered placeholders (e.g. "[image 1]", "[image 2]", "[video 1]", "[document 1]") at their position. You cannot see their contents, but you should acknowledge that the attachment exists.

OUTPUT
Return ONLY valid minified JSON in this exact shape:
  { "report": { "meta": {...}, "weather": ..., "workers": ..., "materials": [...], "issues": [...], "nextSteps": [...], "sections": [...] } }

- Always return the FULL report. Include every top-level field, even when empty.
- Use null for missing "weather" / "workers", [] for empty arrays, "" for missing strings.
- Do NOT wrap the JSON in markdown fences. Do NOT add prose before or after.

SCHEMA
"meta":          { "title": str, "reportType": "site_visit|daily|inspection|safety|incident|progress", "summary": str, "visitDate": "YYYY-MM-DD"|null }
"weather":       { "conditions", "temperature", "wind", "impact" }              (object or null)
"workers":       { "totalWorkers": num, "workerHours", "notes",
                   "roles": [{ "role", "count": num, "notes" }] }                (object or null)
"materials":     [{ "name", "quantity", "quantityUnit", "condition", "status", "notes" }]
"issues":        [{ "title", "category", "severity", "status", "details", "actionRequired" }]
"nextSteps":     [str]
"sections":      [{ "title", "content": "markdown" }]

RULES
- Populate "meta.title" with a short, human-readable title (e.g. "Site Visit — Wet Weather") and "meta.summary" with a one-sentence overview.
- Use sections to capture work progress, observations, and narrative detail. Materials list everything mentioned (concrete, steel, timber, pipes, etc.) — do NOT extract cost/price information; that's handled outside this flow.
- NEVER invent data not in the notes. Keep strings concise. Deduplicate facts.

EXAMPLE
{ "report": { "meta": { "title": "Site Visit — Wet Weather", "reportType": "daily", "summary": "Wet conditions delayed concrete pour", "visitDate": null }, "weather": { "conditions": "wet", "temperature": "20C", "wind": null, "impact": "Pour delayed by 1 hour" }, "workers": null, "materials": [{ "name": "Concrete", "quantity": "50", "quantityUnit": "m³", "condition": null, "status": "delivered", "notes": null }], "issues": [], "nextSteps": ["Order rebar"], "sections": [{ "title": "Foundation Work", "content": "Concrete pour started in zone A despite wet weather." }] } }
userPrompt:
NOTES:
[1] first truck just arrived, 7 oh 5. Hanson concrete, 6 cubes of 32 MPA with 100 slump. docket number is H 445821. driver was Pete
[2] second concrete truck rolling in now at 7:20. another 6 cubes same spec. docket is H 445822
[3] third and final concrete truck for the morning pour. quarter to 8. 4 cubes this time. docket H 445823. so thats 16 cubes total which is spot on what we ordered
[4] Boral timber truck showed up at 8:30. 2 packs of 90 by 45 H2 treated pine, 100 lengths total at 5.4 metres. delivery note is BT 98234. all straight no rejects
[5] plumbing supplies from Reece arrived about quarter past 9. 30 metres of 15 mil copper pipe, 20 metres of 20 mil copper, box of assorted fittings, and 2 Rinnai hot water units. checked against the order and one fitting pack is missing. we ordered 3 packs of 15 mil elbows and only got 2. called Reece theyre sending the missing pack this arvo
[6] the missing elbow pack from Reece arrived at 2pm. all sorted now
[7] steel arrived from OneSteel at 10. 3 tonne of reo bar, mix of N12 N16 and N20. all tagged with heat numbers matching the mill certs. unloaded it with the crane into the reo laydown area
[8] insulation batts from Fletcher at 11:30. 40 packs of R2.5 wall batts and 20 packs of R4.0 ceiling batts. stored em in the container to keep dry. thats the full insulation order for the whole job which is good
[9] brickworks truck at 1pm. 6 pallets of face bricks PGH dry pressed in Limestone. about 480 per pallet so just under 3000 bricks. we only ordered 2500 so weve got a few hundred spare which is fine, better too many than too few
[10] electrical gear from Middys at half 2. 5 rolls of 2.5 mil TPS, 5 rolls of 1.5 mil TPS, 3 switchboards, about 80 GPOs, 40 light switches, and a box of miscellaneous bits. the sparky checked it all says its complete
[11] roofing materials from Stratco at 3. 35 sheets of custom orb colorbond in monument colour, each sheet is 6 metres long. also 4 boxes of roofing screws and 2 rolls of sisalation. all looks good. stacked the sheets on bearers off the ground with the protective film still on
[12] rejected delivery: a pallet of tiles showed up from Beaumont tiles but nobody ordered them. wrong site. sent the driver away. not our problem
[13] running total of materials on site now: we've got enough bricks for about 2 more weeks, enough timber to frame level 1 completely, full insulation order stored, full electrical rough-in materials, and roofing materials ready to go once framing is done
[14] materials we still need to order: guttering and downpipes, external cladding, internal plasterboard, doors and frames, and all the finishing hardware. the PM is sorting the orders this week
